title: Hook B: Your camera roll is secretly a closet
brief: The first 8 s of a camera-roll ad, made to stop the scroll at premium quality for $0. For US 18–34s who don't know Curate. Her real camera roll flicks past faster and faster; it stops dead on her ferry photo and the music cuts; the photo grows into the frame and comes alive in 2.5D with "Your camera roll is secretly a closet." behind her; her denim jacket peels off her in slow motion, toward the camera, leaving her in her striped tee.
